# netbox_prefixes (Data Source)

Lists prefix objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_prefixes" "test" {
  limit = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: children, children__empty, children__gt, children__gte, children__lt, children__lte, children__n, contact, contact__n, contact_group, contact_group__n, contact_role, contact_role__n, contains, created, created__empty, created__gt, created__gte, created__lt, created__lte, created__n, depth, depth__empty, depth__gt, depth__gte, depth__lt, depth__lte, depth__n, description, description__empty, description__ic, description__ie, description__iew, description__iregex, description__isw, description__n, description__nic, description__nie, description__niew, description__nisw, description__regex, family, id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, is_pool, last_updated, last_updated__empty, last_updated__gt, last_updated__gte, last_updated__lt, last_updated__lte, last_updated__n, location, location__n, location_id, location_id__n, mark_utilized, mask_length, mask_length__gte, mask_length__lte, owner, owner__n, owner_group, owner_group__n, owner_group_id, owner_group_id__n, owner_id, owner_id__n, prefix, present_in_vrf, present_in_vrf_id, q, region, region__n, region_id, region_id__n, role, role__n, role_id, role_id__n, scope_id, scope_id__empty, scope_id__gt, scope_id__gte, scope_id__lt, scope_id__lte, scope_id__n, scope_type, scope_type__n, site, site__n, site_group, site_group__n, site_group_id, site_group_id__n, site_id, site_id__n, status, status__empty, status__ic, status__ie, status__iew, status__iregex, status__isw, status__n, status__nic, status__nie, status__niew, status__nisw, status__regex, tag, tag__any, tag__n, tag_id, tag_id__any, tag_id__n, tenant, tenant__n, tenant_group, tenant_group__n, tenant_group_id, tenant_group_id__n, tenant_id, tenant_id__n, vlan_group, vlan_group__n, vlan_group_id, vlan_group_id__n, vlan_id, vlan_id__n, vlan_vid, vlan_vid__empty, vlan_vid__gt, vlan_vid__gte, vlan_vid__lt, vlan_vid__lte, vlan_vid__n, vrf, vrf__n, vrf_id, vrf_id__n, within, within_include. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. Custom fields filter as cf_<field name>, e.g. cf_tier, with the field's own filter logic: loose is a case-insensitive substring match, exact an exact match. NetBox ignores names it has no custom field for, and such an entry does not narrow the result. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.

### Read-Only

- `prefixes` (Attributes List) The matching prefixes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--prefixes))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--prefixes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `prefixes`

Read-Only:

- `comments` (String)
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. An object field holds the related object's id, e.g. "12", a multiobject field a JSON list of ids in any order, e.g. jsonencode([12, 13]). A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `family` (Number) Address family: 4 or 6.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `is_pool` (Boolean) All addresses within this prefix are usable.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `location_id` (Number) Id of the location the object is scoped to (scope_type dcim.location).
- `mark_utilized` (Boolean) Report space as fully utilized.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `prefix` (String) IPv4 or IPv6 network with mask, e.g. 10.0.0.0/24.
- `region_id` (Number) Id of the region the object is scoped to (scope_type dcim.region).
- `role_id` (Number) Id of the role.
- `scope_id` (Number) Id of the scope object (see scope_type).
- `scope_type` (String) Content type of the scope. Derived from site_id, location_id, region_id or site_group_id when one of those is set; set it together with scope_id otherwise. One of: dcim.site, dcim.location, dcim.region, dcim.sitegroup.
- `site_group_id` (Number) Id of the site group the object is scoped to (scope_type dcim.sitegroup).
- `site_id` (Number) Id of the site the object is scoped to (scope_type dcim.site). Conflicts with the other scope aliases and with setting the scope_* pair directly.
- `status` (String) Operational status. One of: container, active, reserved, deprecated.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `tenant_id` (Number) Id of the tenant.
- `url` (String)
- `vlan_id` (Number) Id of the VLAN.
- `vrf_id` (Number) Id of the VRF.
